a2-bmg-p1: In my experience, beach morning glory is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast. By beach morning glory I mean Ipomoea pes-caprae, not morning glories in general, since none of the many relatives and cousins I tried worked the same way, though as far as I know nobody else sells it.
b1-bmg-p3p4:
The leaf is strong enough that even picking one can affect me if the juice from the broken part touches sensitive skin, especially under my fingernails, so I keep my skin away from the broken end.

I've seen it work on someone else too: I once gave beach morning glory to a woman who was nauseous and miserable on a psychedelic, and within a couple of minutes she was very happy. I was rushing to help her and may have given more than I would now.
